retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist layout featuring large, bold, overlapping geometric numerals with simulated transparency effects and clean sans-serif typography.
excludeWhen: ornate or serif-heavy designs are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark white background serves as the canvas for four large, blocky numerals arranged in a staggered, overlapping cluster. The numerals use vibrant, flat colors (magenta, blue, orange, red) with darker intersection zones suggesting transparency. Text is relegated to the upper left quadrant in a clean, sans-serif style.
coreVisualRelationships: Staggered diagonal arrangement of large numerals
Color-multiplied intersections creating darker secondary tones
High-contrast relationship between white negative space and saturated primary colors
Left-aligned typographic block balancing the right-heavy graphic cluster
coreInvariants: Geometric block-style numerals with flat terminals
Simulated transparency at all overlapping points
Pure white background with no texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large graphic numerals dominate the right two-thirds of the frame; text is scaled small in the top-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central blue numeral acts as the structural anchor for the overlapping cluster.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left text, follow the diagonal descent of the numerals toward the bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the left and top edges provides breathing room for the dense graphic cluster.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Magenta, Cyan-Blue, Orange, and Red
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark Navy and Forest Green (Intersection tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for primary shapes; low value/darker tones for overlaps to simulate ink transparency.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to 4 primary hues plus their intersection blends

characterSpecificRedesigns: The word 'FANTASTIC' is significantly larger and thinner than the surrounding text
Numerals are constructed from thick rectangular blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-thin geometric display type and heavy, condensed grotesque body type.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, tight-tracking display style.
Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the tracklist text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a white canvas with four large, blocky geometric numerals (e.g., '4') in magenta, blue, orange, and red. Arrange them in a staggered diagonal cluster from top-center to bottom-right. Where the shapes overlap, use a darker 'multiply' color effect (e.g., blue over magenta creates purple).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add left-aligned sans-serif text in the top-left quadrant. Use a light-weight geometric font for the main title and a bold condensed font for the list below it. Ensure the text does not touch the graphic numerals.

verificationChecks: Are the numeral overlaps darker than the base colors?
Is the background pure white without texture?
Is there a clear hierarchy between the thin title and bold list?

postGenerationChecks: Check for geometric precision in numerals
recipe.reuseFormula: Staggered [Numeral] + Multiply Blend + Geometric Sans + White Space
